intent: Misclassify only the current actual closing-delimiter line as prose, retaining parser-based container/open-body classification. A closed token span has one opener, its content lines, and one closer; The hard-break command (breakEdit through the toolbar) must still preserve that closer with an ordinary newline. Native Enter/Shift+Enter remains a separate ordinary-newline path under the approved 2026-11-21 mapping.
